findings.title: An operator-requested boundary pause ends the viewer with exit 1 and the reason "failed", and says nothing
A supervisor that halts or auto-pauses leaves no persisted reason; status, doctor and attention stay silent
A denied process probe exits 12 while the operator reference promises "pid is gone, regardless of errno"; the change has no changelog entry
status and attach never show the stored pause reason, whether the operator, a stop or a systemic park wrote it
doctor reports ok: false on a freshly initialised project, with an errno as the check status, and exits 0
A corrupted state.json cannot be recovered with state restore even when a valid .bak sits next to it
An empty XDG_CONFIG_HOME or XDG_STATE_HOME redirects config and fleet-state resolution to the current directory
pause and resume answer only "state revision N", even when nothing is running or launched
The pinned Python 3.12.13 is not what the project runs or installs: the venv is 3.13.18, a fresh onboard would pick 3.14.10, CI tests 3.12
Each finished session re-reads every retained session's metrics file, quadratic over a run
phase_repeats survives resume, so every run after a no-progress pause pauses again after one session
stop with no live run reports a "running supervisor" and a missing run.json errno
Plain status and doctor print the same single-line JSON as --json
complete-prd accepts a PRD still in backlog and select re-picks a completed PRD; OVCAQ never guards the done move
logs purge --apply prints a Python RuntimeWarning with a source path, and purged sessions stay in the metrics
Every operator-issued park is labelled wrapper_died
state restore after a completed park silently re-opens the park's recorded step and fences every other command
Stale fleet-registry entries left by a killed supervisor are never pruned
status reports state: invalid when the document is intact and only the lock file is unopenable
Every --help lists options without descriptions, and the protected-path error does not name --unsafe
The fleet TUI offers no key hints and ignores ?; a theme failure is a bare token
CI does not run the locked check implementations the README says it shares with ./tools/check
CHANGELOG scope prefixes do not follow the stated convention
An unknown-tier preflight failure leaves run-terminal.json and run.lock behind although the reference says failures remove what they wrote
README says every file in tools/ is a shim for a same-named mise task; tools/autopilot-prerequisites is neither
Every agent frame is JSON-parsed twice and every observation sanitized three times
logs decodes every retained session's meta.json to find the newest one
Every state command decodes, validates and deep-copies the whole document; a one-field write serializes it three times and reads the whole backup (no-budget observation)
Over-limit string rejections happen only after reading and validating the whole state and backup
A secret split across consecutive agent output frames is stored unredacted in normalized.jsonl
The controller client accepts a world-readable actor credential file without warning
